venues.blockingReason: PRODUCTION DISPOSITION SUPERSEDED / TRANSCRIPTION DEFECT (RAIBOC + CHIBA PRODUCTION DISPOSITION RECONCILIATION AUDIT 2026-08-31): the promoted configuration raiboc-hall-large-standard/standard does not reproduce the current official 座席表 printed ID set, so the 2026-08-31 production promotion is superseded and the record returns to blocked. Machine cell recount of the unchanged current chart (SHA-256 a0bd5467ad87d6cc1ce26cf6b56d0cfc8c37f3dc5bdb60e39334003aedebac81) gives 1F 938 / 2F 431 / balcony 28 = 1,397 printed numbered seats, which matches the chart header (1階席938席・2階席431席・バルコニー28席) exactly and, with the 3 unnumbered 多目的鑑賞室 positions, its own 計1400席; so this is a repository transcription defect, not an unexplained issuer relation. Confirmed defects: (a) 2F row 2A (left 3-9, right 39-45) is printed on the chart and entirely absent from the registered ranges; (b) a further side-only 2F row between 2A and 2B (left 2-9, right 39-47) is also absent; (c) the 2G-2K side blocks are printed as split outer/inner blocks whose row ownership does not match the registered ranges; (d) 1F rows B/D/F/H are registered as contiguous ranges that include a seat 31 which is not printed (those rows end at 30 while A/C/E/G/I end at 31), adding 4 phantom seats. The historical implementation report is retained: its currentness, configuration and evidence work stands, but its seat set is not valid. REOPEN CONDITION: a separately authorized bounded re-implementation that re-transcribes the 2F in full (row 2A included) from the current official 座席表 PDF with two independent passes, resolves the 2G-2K outer/inner side-block row ownership from the chart structure, removes the non-printed seat 31 from 1F rows B/D/F/H, and closes with per-area mapped totals of 1F 938 / 2F 431 / balcony 28 against the issuer subtotals.
